signature_moves: Lofi 'vibe' art card as first-class content — a large rounded rotating AI-mascot illustration + caption carries the entire product personality inside the popover
Green 'Done' as the single saturated action on any surface — off-accent completion semantic, Von Restorff by construction
Whole-panel theming (default / cream / blue) recolors ground, cards and the floating mini window as a set
Maximal menu-bar-extra: task + timer + notify + Apple Reminders + quick note + music player + weekly review stats all stacked in one ~360px dropdown
defects: Tracked-UPPERCASE accent-coloured section headers — inverts the #1 sidebar/section authenticity tell (should be sentence-case, secondary grey, system font, no accent tint); appears on FOCUS REVIEW / WEEKLY SESSIONS / PRO FEATURES and the tab labels
Custom segmented 'tab bar' for Settings navigation — 'a toolbar is not a tab bar'; native macOS Settings uses a real toolbar of normal-case tab items
Contrast Dilution — task title grey-on-grey in header card; row subtitles very light grey (below 4.5:1, worst on cream theme)
Per-row '>' chevrons on popover rows — iOS/Catalyst navigation affordance in a mac popover
Accent not fully bound — blue selection/switches, accent-tinted headers, and a green primary give three colour jobs no single system-accent binding

aesthetic.direction: Playful/toy family crossed with soft consumer-utility: rounded pills throughout, pastel-blue accent, one saturated green completion action, and a saturated illustrated mascot 'vibe' card carrying the personality; swappable warm themes (cream) — deliberately not neo-grotesque, not editorial

psychology: Von Restorff effect — the lone saturated green 'Done' is the one different thing, so the completion action is pre-attentively findable and rewarding
Zeigarnik / Goal-Gradient — pervasive progress signals (23/44 & 33/46 counters, 'Streak 7 days', Daily Goal meter, weekly-sessions bars) exploit incomplete-task nagging and acceleration near goals
Peak-End Rule — investment in the emotional peak/end: mascot art + the celebratory green Done at task completion, not evenly spread polish
Aesthetic-Usability Effect — the cozy illustration buys forgiveness for a dense, feature-maximal menu-bar dropdown
Hick's Law (tension) — stacking task/notify/reminders/notes/player/options/quit in one popover risks choice overload at a glance; acceptable as a browse workspace but the surface is busy
Jakob's Law — familiar iOS-style grouped-settings + switches read instantly to consumers, at a cost to strict mac-nativeness
notes: First app digested into this corpus (only the macOS-27 kit preceded it). cover.jpg and shot-1.jpg are the SAME marketing composite (identical popover UI over a brand blue gradient) — backdrop + headline are brand evidence, not app design. shot-2 (full-screen blocking break view) is heavily blurred — structure only, scored 0/insufficient-evidence. Floating mini window read from a small crop — insufficient-evidence, structure only. Lineage is the key open question: genuine Settings-window chrome + native-style switches + macOS 13pt density point to custom-styled SwiftUI (native, med confidence), but the surface is so heavily re-skinned (tracked-uppercase accent headers, custom tab bar, per-row chevrons, non-accent green primary) that little should feed macOS canon — treat most readings as tells-with-corrections, not native taste. Three visible themes mean color tokens are theme-dependent; values above are the default/light theme unless named. All pixel values (estimated) from downscaled 1280px marketing composites — wide ranges, no @2x source.
